_comment: Revenue-weighted segment look-through for multi-segment issuers (design home/v005, scripts/lib/market_risk/lookthrough.py issuer_segments_for). OPERATOR-OWNED WEIGHTS: an agent may propose an entry with status PROPOSED; only status APPROVED is ever used in a number. Ships empty: the operator approves the weights later.

<TICKER>.name: issuer name

segments.group: sector or theme key from config/market_risk_policy.yaml sectors (e.g. industrials, comm, ai_basket)

<TICKER>.source: filing, section and period the weights come from

_schema._rules: Sector-kind weights sum to 1.0 within 0.01; theme weights (ai_basket, semis) are extra and overlap a sector. Stale after issuer_segments.stale_after_days in config/market_risk_policy.yaml.

SPCX.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX), Class A common stock, Nasdaq

segments.segment: Space (Launch Services $1,130M + Launch & Development $637M; Falcon/Dragon/Starship launch, NASA and national-security launch work)
segments.source: SpaceX 10-Q Q3 2026, Note 3 revenue by type and segment + Note 18 Segments; filed 2026-10-22; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/spcx-20260930.htm

segments.segment: Connectivity (Starlink: Consumer $3,121M + Enterprise & Government incl. Starlink Mobile $2,127M)

segments.source: SpaceX 10-Q Q3 2026, Note 3 revenue by type and segment; filed 2026-10-22; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/spcx-20260930.htm

segments.segment: SI segment - SI Solutions & Infrastructure (cloud/reserved GPU compute contracts, Grok, Cursor, X subscriptions, data licensing, Grok API)
segments.source: SpaceX 10-Q Q3 2026, Note 3 revenue by type and segment; filed 2026-10-22; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/spcx-20260930.htm

segments.segment: AI theme overlay at the capex share (operator option 'A + capex AI'): raises only the ai_basket theme; overlaps tech and is never summed with the sector weights
segments.basis: capital-expenditure share of the AI segment, 83.9% (proposal option 'A + capex overlay'); theme overlay, not part of the sector sum
segments.source: SpaceX 10-Q Q3 2026, Note 3 revenue by type and segment; filed 2026-10-22; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/spcx-20260930.htm

SPCX.source: SpaceX Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-09-30 (filed 2026-10-22, accession 0001628280-26-066880), Notes 3 and 18, quarter revenue; AI overlay = capex share
SPCX.approved_by: operator in-session 2026-11-01, verbatim: "A + capex AI" (relayed by coordinator session_01GeLa7JgVXENzWSJSDhcHkF; recorded under AGENTS.md §20)
